name: TextIn xParse·智能文档解析
description: Parse PDFs, images, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, scanned documents, and more into Markdown or structured JSON from the command line. Preserve document hierarchies and complex table structures for high-accuracy, high-performance document processing. Parse up to 1,000 pages free each day.
